description: List the nationally recognised first aid and CPR courses Australia Wide First Aid runs, with unit code (HLTAID009/011/012), price in AUD, duration, delivery (including any online pre-course learning) and renewal period. Use this to turn a need like "first aid for work" or "childcare certificate" into a course id for the other tools.
name: list_courses

code.description: The national unit code, such as HLTAID011.

delivery.description: How the course is delivered, including any e-Learning pre-work.

duration.description: How long the course takes, as the site describes it.

id.description: The course's slug, such as first-aid. Every other endpoint accepts it as course.

price_aud.description: The standard price in Australian dollars, GST included.

price_display.description: The price as the site shows it, such as $97.

renewal.description: How often the certificate should be renewed.

url.description: The course's page on the site.

title: List first aid courses
